2700.meaning1: to convey a meaning; to make a point
2700.meaningLit: for the communication of a meaning

examples.text: upamā kho my'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, katā atthassa viññāpanāya. ayaṃ c'ev'ettha attho, samatittiko telapatto'ti kho, bhikkhave, kāyagatāya etaṃ satiyā adhivacanaṃ.
upamā kho me ayaṃ, sunakkhatta, katā atthassa viññāpanāya.

2702.commentary: (THa) atthass'āyaṃ viññāpanī'ti satthu guṇasaṅkhātassa upameyy'atthassa viññāpanī, pakāsanī ayaṃ nāg'ūpamā.

examples.text: atthass'āyaṃ viññāpanī, upamā viññūhi desitā, viññissanti mahānāgā, nāgaṃ nāgena desitaṃ.
idh'āgamā vijjupabhāsavaṇṇā, kokanadā pajjunnassa dhītā, buddhañ'ca dhammañ'ca namassamānā, gāthā'c'imā atthavatī abhāsi.

2708.meaning2: possessing the goal; or possessing worldly knowledge

examples.text: etam'atthavasaṃ ñatvā, paṇḍito sīlasaṃvuto, nibbānagamanaṃ maggaṃ, khippam'eva visodhaye.
kiñ'ca, bhikkhave, atthavasaṃ paṭicca, byādhidhammomhi, byādhiṃ anatīto'ti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā?
kaṃ pana bhavaṃ vacchāyano atthavasaṃ sampassamāno samaṇe gotame evaṃ abhippasanno'ti?

2712.meaning1: with a purpose; with a goal in mind
2712.commentary: (SNa) kulaputtā upenti atthavasikā'ti mama sāsane jātikulaputtā ca ācārakulaputtā ca atthavasikā kāraṇavasikā hutvā kāraṇavasaṃ paṭicca upenti.

examples.text: atthavasikena, bhikkhave, kulaputtena alaṃ upagantuṃ. taṃ kissa hetu?
tañ'ca kho etaṃ, bhikkhave, kulaputtā upenti atthavasikā, atthavasaṃ paṭicca, n'eva rāj'ābhinītā, na cor'ābhinītā, na iṇ'aṭṭā, na bhay'aṭṭā, na ājīvik'āpakatā.

2714.meaning1: who speaks what is beneficial; who says what is meaningful

examples.text: kālavādī bhūtavādī atthavādī dhammavādī vinayavādī nidhānavatiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti kālena sāpadesaṃ pariyantavatiṃ atthasaṃhitaṃ

2716.meaning1: knowing how to evaluate what's beneficial
2716.commentary: (ANa) atthavinicchayaññū'ti kāraṇ'atthavinicchaye kusalo. (JAa) atthavinicchayaññū'ti tassa tassa atthassa vinicchayakusalo.

examples.text: yato ca kho paṇḍito āpadāsu, na vedhatī atthavinicchayaññū, paccatthikāssa dukhitā bhavanti, disvā mukhaṃ avikāraṃ purāṇaṃ.

2717.meaning1: inspiration from the meaning; (comm) inspiration from the commentary

examples.text: yathodhi kho pan'assa cattaṃ hoti vantaṃ muttaṃ pahīnaṃ paṭinissaṭṭhaṃ, so buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgatomhī'ti labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhamm'ūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmojjaṃ.
ujugatacitto kho pana, mahānāma, ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhamm'ūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmojjaṃ.

2718.grammar: ind, adv, in comps, acc sg of attha
2718.meaning1: for the sake; for the purpose; for the benefit (of)

examples.text: na'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, brahmacariyaṃ vussati janakuhan'atthaṃ, na janalapan'atthaṃ, na lābhasakkārasilok'ānisaṃs'atthaṃ, na itivādappamokkh'ānisaṃs'atthaṃ, na iti maṃ jano jānātū'ti

2719.meaning1: will achieve one's goal; will accomplish one's purpose; will succeed

examples.text: yañ'c'assa sārena sārakaraṇīyaṃ tañ'c'assa atthaṃ anubhavissatī'ti.

2720.meaning1: fulfills the need (of); achieves a purpose; attains a goal
2720.commentary: (VINa) na taṃ tassa bhikkhuno kiñci atthaṃ anubhotī'ti taṃ cīvaracetāpannaṃ tassa bhikkhuno kiñci appamattakam'pi kammaṃ na nipphādeti. (MNa) tañ'c'assa atthaṃ anubhontī'ti yesaṃ maggaphalānaṃ atthāya pariyāpuṇanti. suggahitapariyattiṃ nissāya maggaṃ bhāvetvā phalaṃ sacchikarontā tañ'c'assa dhammassa atthaṃ anubhavanti. paravāde upārambhaṃ āropetuṃ sakkontā'pi sakavāde āropitaṃ dosaṃ icchit'icchitaṭṭhānaṃ gahetvā mocetuṃ sakkontā'pi anubhonti'y'eva.

examples.text: no ce abhinipphādeyya, yat'assa cīvaracetāpannaṃ ābhataṃ tattha sāmaṃ vā gantabbaṃ dūto vā pāhetabbo, yaṃ kho tumhe āyasmanto bhikkhuṃ uddissa cīvaracetāpannaṃ pahiṇittha na taṃ tassa bhikkhuno kiñci atthaṃ anubhoti. yuñjant'āyasmanto sakaṃ, mā vo sakaṃ vinassā'ti.
yassa c'atthāya dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇanti tañ'c'assa atthaṃ anubhonti. tesaṃ te dhammā suggahitā dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya saṃvattanti.

2721.meaning1: understands the meaning; comprehends the sense (of)
2721.commentary: (MNa) evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājāneyyun'ti ettha ke bhagavato imassa bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānanti, ke na ājānantī'ti?

examples.text: tena, h'āvuso kaccāna, upamaṃ te karissāmi. upamāya'p'idh'ekacce viññū purisā bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānanti.
yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ, bhikkhu, mayā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāsī'ti?

2722.commentary: (ANa) atthaṃ gacchati yattha cā'ti yasmiṃ ṭhāne nirujjhati, tañ'ca jānitvā. (DHPa) atthaṃ gacchantī'ti evarūpānaṃ sabbe'pi āsavā atthaṃ vināsaṃ n'atthibhāvaṃ gacchantī'ti attho.

examples.text: sadā jāgaramānānaṃ, ahoratt'ānusikkhinaṃ, nibbānaṃ adhimuttānaṃ, atthaṃ gacchanti āsavā.
rūpasokhummataṃ ñatvā, vedanānañ'ca sambhavaṃ, saññā yato samudeti, atthaṃ gacchati yattha ca, saṅkhāre parato ñatvā, dukkhato no ca attato.

2723.meaning1: acts for the benefit; works for the welfare (of)

examples.text: na, bhikkhave, tathāgato idān'eva lokassa atthaṃ carati, pubbe'pi cari'y'evā'ti

2724.meaning1: will not achieve one's goal; will not accomplish one's purpose; will not succeed

examples.text: yañ'c'assa sārena sārakaraṇīyaṃ tañ'c'assa atthaṃ n'ānubhavissatī'ti.
accī yathā vātavegena khittā, atthaṃ paleti na upeti saṅkhaṃ, evaṃ munī nāmakāyā vimutto, atthaṃ paleti na upeti saṅkhaṃ.

2726.meaning1: advice for welfare; instruction for benefit
2726.commentary: (DNa) atth'ānusiṭṭhīsu pariggahesu cā'ti ye atth'ānusāsanesu pariggahā atth'ānatthaṃ pariggāhakāni ñāṇāni, tesū'ti attho.

examples.text: sace na pabbajjam'upeti tādiso, vatteti cakkaṃ pathaviṃ pasāsati, atth'ānusiṭṭhīsu pariggahesu ca, na tena seyyo sadiso ca vijjati.

2727.meaning1: comprehension of what is beneficial; understanding what is good

examples.text: diṭṭhe dhamme ca yo attho, yo c'attho samparāyiko, atth'ābhisamayā dhīro, paṇḍito'ti pavuccatī'ti.

2728.meaningLit: for the good, the benefit and the happiness

examples.text: caratha, bhikkhave, cārikaṃ bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lok'ānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ, mā ekena dve agamittha

ye te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū suggahitehi sutt'antehi (na) byañjanappatirūpakehi atthañ'ca dhammañ'ca anulomenti te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bahujanahitāya paṭipannā bahujanasukhāya, bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ.

2729.grammar: masc, in comps, dat sg of atthāya (+gen)
2729.meaning1: for the purpose; for the sake; for the benefit (of)

examples.text: yassa khv'āhaṃ atthāya cittaṃ paṇidahiṃ so me attho abhinipphanno
atthāya vata me buddho, nadiṃ nerañjaraṃ agā, yass'āhaṃ dhammaṃ sutvāna, micchādiṭṭhiṃ vivajjayiṃ.
ta'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, hoti bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya, bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānan'ti.

2735.meaning1: there is, friend; there is, brother

examples.text: kahaṃ pana, bhikkhu, eta'r'ahi so bhagavā viharati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho'ti. atth'āvuso, uttaresu janapadesu sāvatthi nāma nagaraṃ. tattha so bhagavā eta'r'ahi viharati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho'ti.
atthi, bhikkhave, ajātaṃ abhūtaṃ akataṃ asaṅkhataṃ
paccati munino bhattaṃ, thokaṃ thokaṃ kule kule, piṇḍikāya carissāmi, atthi jaṅghābalaṃ mamā'ti.
ye diṭṭhim'uggayha vivādayanti, idam'eva saccan'ti ca vādayanti, te tvaṃ vadassū na hi te'dha atthi, vādamhi jāte paṭisenikattā.
ye keci pāṇabhūt'atthi, tasā vā thāvarā vā anavasesā, dīghā vā y'eva mahantā vā, majjhimā rassakā aṇukathūlā.

2738.meaning1: seeker; who wants; who needs; who desires

examples.text: evaṃ abhikkantadassāviṃ, atthi pañhena āgamaṃ, kathaṃ lokaṃ avekkhantaṃ, maccurājā na passati.
anejaṃ mūladassāviṃ, atthi pañhena āgamaṃ, kiṃ nissitā isayo manujā, khattiyā brāhmaṇā devatānaṃ, yaññam'akappayiṃsu puthū'dha loke, pucchāmi taṃ bhagavā brūhi me taṃ.

2739.synonym: atthakara, atthakaraṇa, atthāvaha, upakāra, kusala, sapayojana, sappayojana, sātthaka, sānisaṃsa, hita

examples.text: satiñ'ca khv'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, sabb'atthikaṃ vadāmī'ti.

2740.synonym: anucchavi, anucchavika, anurūpa, anulomika, paṭirūpa, patirūpa, patirūpī, yutta, yuttaka, yuttarūpa, sāmīcika, sāruppa

examples.text: kappiyaṃ taṃ ce chādeti, cīvaraṃ idam'atthikaṃ, alaṃ phāsuvihārāya, pahit'attassa bhikkhuno.

2741.grammar: adj, in comps, from attha (+acc or +instr)
2741.synonym: aṭṭhiya, attha, atthī, anugiddha, apekkha, abhijjhāyanta, ākaṅkhanta, ākaṅkhamāna, iccha, icchaka, icchanta, icchamāna, kāmaka, kāmayamāna, kāmayāna, kāmī, chādayamāna, jappanta, jigiṃsanta, jigiṃsāna, jigīsaka, jigīsanta, jigīsamāna, jigīsāna

examples.text: yāya devā manussā ca, sitā tiṭṭhanti atthikā, tarath'etaṃ visattikaṃ, khaṇo vo mā upaccagā, khaṇ'ātītā hi socanti, nirayamhi samappitā.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso alagadd'atthiko alagaddagavesī alagaddapariyesanaṃ caramāno. so passeyya mahantaṃ alagaddaṃ. tam'enaṃ bhoge vā naṅguṭṭhe vā gaṇheyya.

2742.meaning1: believing in the efficacy of action and the existence of the afterlife

examples.text: kāmaṃ kho pana m'āhu paro loko, hotu nesaṃ bhavataṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ saccaṃ vacanaṃ, atha ca pan'āyaṃ bhavaṃ purisapuggalo diṭṭh'eva dhamme viññūnaṃ pāsaṃso, sīlavā purisapuggalo sammādiṭṭhi atthikavādo'ti.

2743.meaning2: state of seeking, state of being in need of; needing

examples.text: atthikavato kho pana te, ambaṭṭha, idh'āgamanaṃ ahosi, yāy'eva kho pan'atthāya āgaccheyyātha, tam'eva atthaṃ sādhukaṃ manasi kareyyātha.

2746.meaning1: (proponent of) moral effectiveness; doctrine of ethical efficacy; view that merit and the afterlife exist
2746.meaning2: doctrine that (merit, another world, etc.) exists
2746.commentary: (MNa) atthikavādan'ti atthi dinnaṃ dinnaphalan'ti imaṃ atthikavādaṃ'y'eva vadanti tesaṃ tucchaṃ vacanaṃ musāvilāpo.

examples.text: kāmaṃ kho pana m'āhu paro loko, hotu nesaṃ bhavataṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ saccaṃ vacanaṃ, atha ca pan'āyaṃ bhavaṃ purisapuggalo diṭṭh'eva dhamme viññūnaṃ pāsaṃso, sīlavā purisapuggalo sammādiṭṭhi atthikavādo'ti.

2747.meaning1: who is a proponent of moral effectiveness; supporting the doctrine of ethical efficacy; having the view that merit and the afterlife exist
2747.commentary: (MNa) atthikavādan'ti atthi dinnaṃ dinnaphalan'ti imaṃ atthikavādaṃ'y'eva vadanti tesaṃ tucchaṃ vacanaṃ musāvilāpo.

examples.text: kāmaṃ kho pana m'āhu paro loko, hotu nesaṃ bhavataṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ saccaṃ vacanaṃ, atha ca pan'āyaṃ bhavaṃ purisapuggalo diṭṭh'eva dhamme viññūnaṃ pāsaṃso, sīlavā purisapuggalo sammādiṭṭhi atthikavādo'ti.

2748.meaning1: existence; idea of existence; fact of being present

examples.text: dvayanissito khv'āyaṃ, kaccāna, loko yebhuyyena, atthitañ'c'eva n'atthitañ'ca. lokasamudayaṃ kho, kaccāna, yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passato yā loke n'atthitā sā na hoti. lokanirodhaṃ kho, kaccāna, yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passato yā loke atthitā sā na hoti.
idāni pana sūriy'ālokassa atthitāya padīpakiccaṃ idha n'atthi
examples.source: VIN PAT PK saṅghuposatha pubbakaraṇādi vidhi

2749.meaningLit: discourse on is there a way
2749.sanskrit: asti + nu + khalu + paryāya + sūkta, sūtra (bsk)

2750.meaning2: existence; the fact of being present

examples.text: rūparāgappaṭisaṃvedī'ti kilesassa atthibhāven'eva pana rūparāgaṃ paṭisaṃviditaṃ karoti nāma

2751.meaning1: for the purpose (of); useful (for); for the sake (of)

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, rāhula, kim'atthiyo ādāso'ti? paccavekkhaṇ'attho, bhante'ti.
paññā pan'āvuso, kim'atthiyā'ti?

2752.synonym: attha, atthī, anugiddha, apekkha, abhijjhāyanta, ākaṅkhanta, ākaṅkhamāna, iccha, icchaka, icchanta, icchamāna, kāmaka, kāmayamāna, kāmayāna, kāmī, chādayamāna, jappanta, jigiṃsanta, jigiṃsāna, jigīsaka, jigīsanta, jigīsamāna, jigīsāna

examples.text: kadā nu maṃ tandi khudā pipāsā, vāt'ātapā kīṭasarīsapā vā, na bādhayissanti na taṃ giribbaje, atth'atthiyaṃ taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.

2753.synonym: atthakara, atthasañhita, atthasaṃhita, atthūpasaṃhita, upakāra, upabhoga, kusala, bhogga, sapayojana, sappayojana, sātthaka, sānisaṃsa

examples.text: kiñ'ca, bhikkhave, atthisammataṃ loke paṇḍitānaṃ, yam'ahaṃ atthī'ti vadāmi? viññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ atthisammataṃ loke paṇḍitānaṃ, aham'pi taṃ atthī'ti vadāmi.

2756.meaning1: pleasure of having; happiness of ownership

examples.text: cattār'imāni, gahapati, sukhāni adhigamanīyāni gihinā kāmabhoginā kālena kālaṃ samayena samayaṃ upādāya. katamāni cattāri? atthisukhaṃ, bhogasukhaṃ, ānaṇyasukhaṃ, anavajjasukhaṃ.

2758.meaning1: may it be!; may there be!

examples.text: dhī taṃ jammi jare atthu, dubbaṇṇakaraṇī jare, tāva manoramaṃ bimbaṃ, jarāya abhimadditaṃ.
asa'icc'etāya dhātuyā tussa vibhattissa tthuttaṃ hoti, dhātv'antassa lopo ca. atthu.

2760.meaning1: investigation of the meaning; examination of the significance

examples.text: tassa sādhū'ti bhāsitaṃ abhinanditabbaṃ anumoditabbaṃ, tassa sādhū'ti bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā so evam'assa vacanīyo, lābhā no āvuso, suladdhaṃ no āvuso, ye mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ tādisaṃ sabrahmacāriṃ passāma evaṃ atth'upetaṃ byañjan'upetan'ti.

2762.meaning1: (preaching of a sutta owing to) an arisen need

examples.text: ath'assa etadahosi, hand'āhaṃ imaṃ pañhaṃ gahetvā bhagavantaṃ pucchāmi, addhā me bhagavā imaṃ atth'uppattiṃ katvā sālindaṃ sineruṃ ukkhipanto viya ekaṃ sutt'antakathaṃ kathetvā dassessati.

2763.meaning1: (of a discourse's origin) on account of an arisen need
2763.meaning2: sutta delivered on account of a need arisen
2763.commentary: (DNt) araṇīyato avagantabbato attho vuccati suttadesanāya vatthu, tassa uppatti atth'uppatti, sā eva aṭṭh'uppatti ttha-kārassa ṭṭha-kāraṃ katvā, sā etassa atthi vuttanayenā'ti aṭṭh'uppattiko.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutan'ti cūḷasīhanādasuttaṃ. yasmā pan'assa atth'uppattiko nikkhepo, tasmā taṃ dassetvā c'assa anupubbapadavaṇṇanaṃ karissāma. katarāya pan'idaṃ atthuppattiyā nikkhittan'ti?

2764.construction:
attha + uppatti + vasa + ena
atthuppattivasa + ena

examples.text: kiṃ nu te vaṅg'īsā'ti idaṃ bhagavā atth'uppattivasena āha. saṅghamajjhe kira kathā udapādi vaṅg'īsatthero vissaṭṭhavatto, n'eva uddese, na paripucchāya, na yonisomanasikāre kammaṃ karoti, gāthā bandhanto cuṇṇiyapadāni karonto vicaratī'ti.

2765.meaning1: investigation of the meaning; examination of the significance

examples.text: sā'pi nāma, bhikkhave, dhammadhāraṇā n'āhosi, sā'pi nāma, bhikkhave, atth'ūpaparikkhā n'āhosi, sā'pi nāma, bhikkhave, dhammanijjhānakkhanti n'āhosi, so'pi nāma, bhikkhave, chando n'āhosi, so'pi nāma, bhikkhave, ussāho n'āhosi, sā'pi nāma, bhikkhave, tulanā n'āhosi

2766.meaning1: investigator of the meaning; who examines the sense

2767.meaning1: who investigates the meaning; who examines the implications (of)

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo khippanisantī ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu, sutānañ'ca dhammānaṃ dhārakajātiko hoti, dhātānañ'ca dhammānaṃ atth'ūpaparikkhī hoti attham'aññāya dhammam'aññāya, dhamm'ānudhammappaṭipanno hoti.

2768.meaning1: connected with the goal; concerning the ultimate aim; (comm) supported by the commentary

examples.text: dhammo nāma buddhabhāsito, sāvakabhāsito, isibhāsito, devatābhāsito, atth'ūpasañhito, dhamm'ūpasañhito.

2769.commentary: (DNa) atth'ūpasaṃhitan'ti idhalokaparalok'atthanissitaṃ. (DNt) atth'ūpasaṃhitan'ti iminā vaṭṭanissitā dhammakathā vuttā'ti āha idhalokaparalok'atthanissitan'ti. (NIDD1a) atth'ūpasaṃhitan'ti atthasahitaṃ kāraṇasahitaṃ.

examples.text: yam'pi, bhikkhave, tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussabhūto samāno atth'ūpasaṃhitaṃ dhamm'ūpasaṃhitaṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā ahosi, bahujanaṃ nidaṃsesi, pāṇīnaṃ hitasukh'āvaho dhammayāgī.

vācaṃ pamuñce kusalaṃ n'ātivelan'ti. ñāṇasamuṭṭhitaṃ vācaṃ muñceyya, atth'ūpasaṃhitaṃ dhamm'ūpasaṃhitaṃ kālena sāpadesaṃ pariyantavatiṃ vācaṃ muñceyya pamuñceyyā'ti, vācaṃ pamuñce kusalaṃ. n'ātivelan'ti.

2772.meaning2: meaningful connected with the goal or the meaning

2773.meaning1: and there are some; and there is a certain

2775.meaning1: there is even; there is really; just this is
2775.commentary: (MNa) atth'eva jātī'ti etāya diṭṭhiyā sati brahmacariyavāso'va n'atthi, jāti pana atthi'y'eva. tathā jarāmaraṇ'ādīnī'ti dasseti.

examples.text: rañño'pi kho, bhikkhave, pasenadissa kosalassa atth'eva aññathattaṃ atthi vipariṇāmo. evaṃ passaṃ, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako tasmim'pi nibbindati. tasmiṃ nibbindanto agge virajjati, pag'eva hīnasmiṃ.

sassato loko'ti vā, mālukyaputta, diṭṭhiyā sati, asassato loko'ti vā diṭṭhiyā sati atth'eva jāti, atthi jarā, atthi maraṇaṃ, santi soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsā, yes'āhaṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme nighātaṃ paññapemi.

2777.meaning2: connected with the goal, or with what is beneficial

examples.text: pahūtaputto bhavatī tathāvidho, parosahassañ'ca bhavanti atrajā, sūrā ca vīrā ca amittatāpanā, gihissa pītiṃjananā piyaṃvadā.
pun'āparaṃ yadā homi, ekarājassa atrajo, nagare pupphavatiyā, kumāro candasavhayo.

2782.commentary: (THIa) dhītā majjhassa atrajā'ti majjhanāmassa seṭṭhino orasā dhītā.

examples.text: ucce kule ahaṃ jātā, bahuvitte mahaddhane, vaṇṇarūpena sampannā, dhītā majjhassa atrajā.

2783.commentary: (VINa) tattha āvuso atraṭṭhito bandhāhī'ti maraṇ'ādhippāyo yatra ṭhito patitvā khāṇunā vā bhijjeyya, sobbhapapāt'ādīsu vā mareyya, tādisaṃ ṭhānaṃ sandhāy'āha.

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi, handa dāni, bhikkhave, āmantayāmi vo, vayadhammā saṅkhārā appamādena sampādethā'ti. ayaṃ tathāgatassa pacchimā vācā.
daḷhāya rajjuyā bandhitvā majjhe gaṇṭhiṃ karitvā ossajjeyya. atha kho, te, bhikkhave, chappāṇakā nānāvisayā nānāgocarā sakaṃ sakaṃ gocaravisayaṃ āviñcheyyuṃ

2789.meaning1: yet; and yet; but; but still; however; even then

examples.text: kiñ'c'āpi te evaṃ vadeyyuṃ piyo no attā'ti atha kho tesaṃ appiyo attā.
appaṃ vata jīvitaṃ idaṃ, oraṃ vassasatā'pi miyyati, yo ce'pi aticca jīvati, atha kho so jarasā'pi miyyati.
ye kho keci bhagavato sāvakā āraddhavīriyā viharanti, ahaṃ tesaṃ aññataro. atha ca pana me na anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccati
atha ca pana bhavaṃ gotamo evam'āha, aham'pi kho, brāhmaṇa, kasāmi ca vapāmi ca. kasitvā ca vapitvā ca bhuñjāmī'ti.

2791.meaning1: but if; and if; so if

examples.text: parassa ce hi vacasā nihīno, tumo sahā hoti nihīnapañño, atha ce sayaṃ vedagū hoti dhīro, na koci bālo samaṇesu atthi.
akkodhano vigatakhilo'ham'asmi, anutīre mahiy'ekarattivāso, vivaṭā kuṭi nibbuto gini, atha ce patthayasī pavassa deva.
sabbattha ve sappurisā cajanti, na kāmakāmā lapayanti santo, sukhena phuṭṭhā atha vā dukhena, na ucc'āvacaṃ paṇḍitā dassayanti.
mātari pitari c'āpi, yo micchā paṭipajjati, tathāgate vā sambuddhe, atha vā tassa sāvake, bahuñ'ca so pasavati, apuññaṃ tādiso naro.

2794.meaning1: then; also; and so; after that

examples.text: sabbe saṅkhārā aniccā'ti, yadā paññāya passati, atha nibbindati dukkhe, esa maggo visuddhiyā.
yadā kho, bhikkhave, kummo kacchapo soṇḍipañcamānaṃ aṅgānaṃ aññataraṃ vā aññataraṃ vā aṅgaṃ na abhininnāmi, atha siṅgālo kummamhā nibbijja pakkāmi, otāraṃ alabhamāno.
appakā te manussesu, ye janā pāragāmino, atha-ayaṃ itarā pajā, tīram'ev'ānudhāvati.
atha pāpāni kammāni, karaṃ bālo na bujjhati, sehi kammehi dummedho, aggidaḍḍho'va tappati.

tesu kira eko devaputto, nakkhattaṃ kīḷissāmī'ti saparivāro rathena vīthiṃ paṭipajjati, ath'añño nikkhamanto taṃ purato gacchantaṃ disvā, bho ayaṃ kapaṇo, adiṭṭhapubbaṃ viya etaṃ disvā, pītiyā uddhumāto viya bhijjamāno viya ca gacchatī'ti kujjhati.

2797.meaning1: not proud; not arrogant; not conceited
2797.meaning2: not proud; not arrogant; lit. not stiff

examples.text: arahante sītībhūte, katakicce anāsave, nihacca mānaṃ athaddho, te namasse anuttare'ti.

atha vā akkodhano hoti anupanāhī, amakkhī hoti apaḷāsī, anissukī hoti amaccharī, asaṭho hoti amāyāvī, athaddho hoti anatimānī, na pāp'iccho hoti na micchādiṭṭhi, asandiṭṭhiparāmāsī hoti anādānaggāhī suppaṭinissaggī, ayaṃ vuccati puggalo ajeguccho.

2799.meaning2: spell or a charm from the Atharva-veda
